accounts.name: Master
accounts.plays: administrator of the Master policy, deploys the choreography type; not an authorized creator

accounts.name: Holder
accounts.plays: eligible holder: holds and edits the instances

accounts.name: Outsider
accounts.plays: an account no choreography policy names

accounts.name: Ineligible holder
accounts.plays: an account the Master policy does not accept as holder

accounts.name: Authorized creator
accounts.plays: the account the Master policy authorizes to mint an instance

accounts.name: Carrier A
accounts.plays: organization qualified for SpecialCarrier, first holder of its license

accounts.name: Carrier B
accounts.plays: organization qualified for SpecialCarrier, buyer of the license

accounts.name: Transport authority
accounts.plays: issuer and certifier of the SpecialCarrier and Carrier licenses

accounts.name: Bulk Buyer authority
accounts.plays: issuer and certifier of the BulkBuyer licenses

accounts.name: Manufacturer authority
accounts.plays: issuer and certifier of the Manufacturer licenses

accounts.name: Middleman authority
accounts.plays: issuer and certifier of the Middleman licenses

accounts.name: Supplier authority
accounts.plays: issuer and certifier of the Supplier licenses

phases.title: Deploy the choreography type and the license infrastructure
Mint the instance for its holder
Issue the participant licenses and link every role to its license
Render the baseline model from the chain
Apply the delta: one allowed update and seven denied ones
Sell the Special Carrier role: Carrier A to Carrier B
Restrict a second instance through its Holder policy
Render the final model from the chain
